sentences.en: Mr Smith takes a good deal of exercise before breakfast.
sentences.zh: 史密斯先生早餐前会做很多运动。

sentences.en: Cycling is good exercise. Moreover, it doesn't pollute the air.
sentences.zh: 骑自行车是个好运动。而且，它不会污染空气。

sentences.en: This is a good exercise to help you lose weight.
sentences.zh: 这是一个帮助你减肥的好练习。
